candidate.title: scTHS-seq
candidate.scope: The scTHS-seq row of the supplied Illumina single-cell poster: single-nucleus DNA-accessibility profiling by Tn5059 barcoded transposition, pool-and-redistribute combinatorial indexing, transcription-based amplification and indexed DNA-library construction. The card title and the row label identify one target; scTHS-Seq and the expanded single-cell transposome hypersensitive-site sequencing label denote this same assay. The neighboring Drop-ChIP and sciHi-C rows and clipped scATAC-Seq row are outside the assigned card. Three tubes at each split illustrate parallel wells, not an asserted three-well implementation. Operations are instantiated per illustrated well; the common reaction cartoons describe processing in each well and do not imply that wells are mixed before final pooling. Paper-supported interfaces clarify the compact cartoon without importing its unshown sample preparation, quality-control experiments or analysis pipeline.

features: Released tagged genomic DNA is the template for engineered RNA production.

evidence.quote: For in vitro transcription (IVT) amplification the NEB HiScribe T7 high yield synthesis kit was used.

evidence.quote: Standard Illumina Nextera XT v2 barcoding in an 8×12 (i5xi7) format was performed with qPCR, using custom scTHS-seq i5 indexes and standard Illumina i7 indexes (Table S12).

Barcode combinations associated with each read were appended to each reads header with in house Perl scripts and all fastq files were combined and mapped to a hg38 no alternative loci plus decoy reference genome (GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_plus_hs38d1_analysis_set) and mm10 no alternative loci reference genome (GCA_000001635.5_GRCm38.p3_no_alt_analysis_set) using BWA 0.7.12-r1039.
For each unique barcode combination, the proportion of unique reads that map to either mouse or human genome was calculated (Table S1).

operations.label: In-vitro transcription amplification
operations.description: In second-round well A, convert the tagged genomic-fragment templates into amplified copies. The compact drawing labels transcription only; the paper-supported outgoing substrate for the next depicted transposition is double-stranded cDNA, reached through an RNA intermediate.

These paper-supported conversions are retained within this broad library-preparation block.
